data.value: {0} condition to meet: Netto cannot check it

data.name: Heading_Many
data.value: {0} conditions to meet: Netto cannot check them

data.name: Condition_written_agreement
data.value: A written individual agreement with the company grants them.

data.name: Condition_not_instead_of_pay
data.value: They are not granted in place of pay, a bonus or another benefit.

data.name: Condition_days_actually_worked
data.value: One meal voucher for each day you actually work, and you can prove those days. A director with no staff qualifies; without that proof, the company's share is taxable pay.

data.name: Condition_in_your_name
data.value: The meal vouchers are electronic, and every voucher is issued in your name.

data.name: Condition_eco_agreement_terms
data.value: For eco vouchers, the agreement states the face value of each, at most {0}, and how often they are granted in the year.

data.name: Condition_directors_case_by_case
data.value: These flat amounts are the ones the administration accepts from an employer, and its circular does not apply them to company directors. A director is reimbursed on documents, or on serious and concordant flat norms judged case by case: an advance ruling from the SDA can confirm a flat amount before you rely on it.

data.name: Condition_no_other_company_share
data.value: The company bears none of these costs otherwise: no utilities paid for the office, no share of the internet bill, no company laptop or tablet beside the computer allowance.

data.name: Condition_office_covers_rent
data.value: The office allowance covers the room, its rent included: you cannot also rent the same room to the company.

data.name: Condition_phone_on_invoices
data.value: For the phone, the company reimburses the professional share of your own bills, on invoices: Netto takes the amount you enter as that share.

data.name: Condition_share_yours_to_justify
data.value: The share let is yours to justify, usually by the floor area the company really uses: the floor and the cap are on the cadastral income of that part.

data.name: Condition_not_with_office_allowance
data.value: No office allowance beside it: the allowance already covers the room, its rent included.

data.name: Condition_ordered_or_leased
data.value: Ordered or leased on the date you give: an order counts from its own date, even before the car is delivered, and a lease or a rental from its contract's; extending a lease beyond what its contract provided, or taking it over, starts a new date. An electric car ordered or leased before 2027 stays deductible in full for as long as the company keeps it.

data.name: Condition_private_use_all_year
data.value: At your disposal for private use for the whole year: the benefit is a year's, and a car you have for only part of it is not modelled yet.

data.name: Condition_fake_hybrid
data.value: A plug-in hybrid bought or leased from 2018 is a fake hybrid when its battery holds less than 0.5 kWh per 100 kg of the car, or it emits more than 50 g/km, 75 g/km when measured under Euro 6e-bis or a later standard: its benefit and its deduction then take the CO2 of the matching car running on its fuel alone, on the SPF's list, or its own CO2 times 2.5 when there is none. You say whether yours is one.
